resources.string: Optional 15-minute checks for this server profile.
No background check has run yet.
No push service. WorkManager checks this server about every 15 minutes and keeps only a small local event feed.
Choose which event kinds may appear in the feed and as notifications.
During this local-time window, events are kept and shown later.
Equal start and end disables the window.
Notification permission is denied. The event feed still updates, but no notification was delivered.
Up to 200 allowlisted events, kept for the server-provided one-week TTL.
No events yet. The first check runs shortly after enabling.
Remove all locally stored events? The server history is not changed.
WorkManager runs a best-effort check about every 15 minutes. Android may delay it when the device is idle, in Doze, or after a force-stop.
There is no instant push. Delivery can be late, and force-stop stops background work until the app is opened again.
The read-only token lasts 30 days. When it expires, enable again to create a new one.
Server alerts are fixed: disk usage at least 90 percent, memory usage at least 95 percent. The app does not change these thresholds.
Battery optimization and vendor restrictions can add further delay. This is an Android limitation, not a server error.
Device, help-request and job events from MeshCentral.
New activity. Open the app to view.
A device resource alert was reported.
Sign in to the server before enabling background events.
The stored notification token belongs to a different account. Enable again.
This server profile no longer exists.
No connection. The cursor is kept and the next check retries.
The server certificate is not trusted by Android. Background events stay off.
The server rejected the background request.
The server rate limit was reached. The next check retries.
The server response was rejected by the strict parser.
The server returned an invalid notification endpoint.
Background events could not be updated.
This profile trusts a self-signed certificate. Background notifications require system-trusted HTTPS; foreground sessions are unaffected.
The notification token expired or was revoked.
The token is no longer valid. Enable again to register a new one. The event feed stays available.
